{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue from string to float, removing commas
df['revenue'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter out QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
non_qa_df = df[df['revenue'] != 999999.99]

# Now filter for target population: new customers via paid_search
target_df = non_qa_df[(non_qa_df['customer_segment'] == 'new') & (non_qa_df['channel'] == 'paid_search')]

# Check for refunded orders in target population
refunded_in_target = target_df[target_df['status'] == 'refunded']
print(f"Number of refunded orders in target population: {len(refunded_in_target)}")

# Check the conversion rate
converted_count = target_df['converted'].sum()
total_count = len(target_df)
conversion_rate = converted_count / total_count

print(f"Converted: {converted_count}")
print(f"Total: {total_count}")
print(f"Conversion rate: {conversion_rate}")"}
